pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Medium-brown patches exhibiting high-frequency serrated edge gradients with star-shaped or vine-leaf-like jagged geometries. Edge angularity is high with sharp pixel-level transitions from dark to light pelage.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A thick, continuous negative-space network of light-cream pelage. Junction nodes are well-defined, primarily consisting of tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections with relatively consistent pixel thickness across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the cervical and dorsal ridge presenting a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette of short, dense hair bundles against the background.
